subject: general
question: The average of 11 observations is 10, that of the first 6 being 9 and that of the last 6 being 11. What is the 6th observation?
solution:
Given:

The average of 11 observations is 10, that of the first 6 being 9 and that of the last 6 being 11.

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

Sum of 11 observations = 11 × 10 = 110

Sum of the first 6 observations = 6 × 9 = 54

Sum of the last 6 observations = 6 × 11 = 66

Now, the 6th observation = (54 + 66 - 110) = 10

**∴ The 6th observation is 10.**
